title: TrueFoundry Forge-a-thon
description: Build a VS Code coding agent with TrueForge. Open to participants aged 18 and over; teams of up to 5. Registration closes 15 Nov 2026; remote round deadline 20 Nov; Techfest IIT Bombay finals 16–18 Dec.

title: AyushTech Innovate: National Open Ayurveda AI Challenge
description: Build source-grounded AI tools for Ayurveda. Teams of 2–4 must include an eligible Ayurveda student; see the official rules. Registration closes 15 Nov 2026; final presentations 15–18 Dec at Techfest IIT Bombay.

title: National Aeromodelling Challenge
description: Student teams design and fly a payload-carrying RC aircraft. Teams of 2–4; registration and abstract submission close 25 Nov 2026. Qualifiers are 15–16 Dec and the main round is 17 Dec at IIT Bombay.

title: Agentic AI in BFSI Hackathon 2026
description: Build AI solutions for banking workflows in a Perfios and Techfest IIT Bombay hackathon. Student teams of up to 4; registration closes 25 Nov 2026, with finals 15–18 Dec. Check the listing for current rules and eligibility.

title: Global Sustainability Challenge 2026–27
description: University student teams develop sustainability solutions in energy or climate resilience. Teams of 1–6; at least one member must meet the organizer's age rule. Registration, team formation and Phase 1 submissions close 22 Nov 2026.
organizer: Global Sustainability Challenge, with IIT Bombay as South Asia partner
